text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Deputy President of Italian-based Intertransportes Centre group, Piero Danto, one of Angola's largest foreign investors, said Angola's economy was on the right track and his company hoped to increase its business in the country.
- Governor of the northern Malange province Flavio Fernandes said full agricultural production in the province was still hampered by landmines.
- The provincial government of Lunda Sul province has approved a three million dollar project to help improve working conditions for journalists in the region.
